[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42398450/ebddaffd3a219659c788b011df391b9c003c7b1b.jpg[/img]

[b]Hey Player![/b]
nice to see you mate : ) 
How is the weather over there in summer? huh? 
We are dying from the hot weather  XD
need to waterMelon.. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42398450/4cf425731db5237dfe2385f6cd8a42e7eb0c27c0.png[/img] 

anyway, today we're going to tell you three things
[olist]
[*] add to more Item (maybe Three more?)
[*] two more battle ship will added this game  
[*] A new enermy wii be added(like a boss type?) 
[/olist]

[b]new Item[/b]
We are planning to add various missile items, so please look forward to it as we are considering balancing this part.

[b]two more battle ship will added this game  [/b]
I'm going to add two BattleShips and I'll let you know when I get a picture later on in the update news.

[b]A new enermy wii be added[/b]
Enemies will also be added, but there is a balance problem with this, so I think I will think about it a little bit.

Anyway, we have these worries! If you have any opinions about our game, feel free to leave a comment because it would be nice if we could make a better casual game!

See you again all : )

notes.title: Open Space Molmae!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42398450/4af851e75f43400fea17e9845b18cc19553cf2bc.gif[/img]

[b]Hi we are Magoojabee Studio[/b]
we open the game today ! 
I am very excited and nervous
Because I didn't know what our little mistake was for a long time.
Nevertheless, I would like to thank those who have added us to the wish list.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42398450/f4665f48fb119b6d6671fff1f673f776483a1ad2.png[/img]
SpaceMolmae is our first steam game.
In fact, it came out on Android first, but the evaluation was not good.
Over time we cared about the balance and replaced the music and Sprite

[i][b]before Player ship[/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42398450/d26e83436bc8c605ad3035a1068de990e3890e7a.png[/img]

This was our first prototype, and it even came out of the mobile in this way but.. yeah, No one was 
playing. :'( 

[i][b]Recently ship[/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42398450/46a75193022854042997dd764286d7977d8478d9.png[/img]

more better right? 
and we add 3 more enermy!
Anyway, it's a very short game, but we worked really hard because we're not Game developers.
so, 
I made a lot of mistakes, but thank you for waiting I'll do my best!
Thank you see you soon next News.

notes.title: Ooops! I'm sorry, users.
